title: Supreme Court Clears Way for Tennessee's Execution of Christa Pike
detail: The US Supreme Court denied Christa Pike's final appeal, clearing the way for Tennessee to proceed with her imminent execution. Pike, convicted of the 1995 murder of a fellow student, would be the first woman executed by Tennessee and the first woman executed in the US since 2014.

media.caption: US Supreme Court denies final appeal for Tennessee death row inmate Christa Pike

title: Polling Shows Americans Souring on Trump's Economic Handling Ahead of Midterms
detail: New polling indicates Americans are increasingly dissatisfied with President Trump's management of the economy and rising prices, a trend analysts describe as a warning sign ahead of midterm elections. The data reflects growing public concern over cost-of-living pressures and inflation.

media.caption: Americans turning against Trump's handling of economy and prices ahead of midterms
